svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Hub-and-spoke network with central inspection on AWS
svg.desc: Hub-and-spoke network with central inspection on AWS. 11 components in 10 groups. Connections: Workload VPCs to AWS Transit Gateway (VPC attachments); AWS Transit Gateway to AWS Network Firewall (inspect); AWS Network Firewall to NAT gateway; NAT gateway to Internet gateway; Internet gateway to Internet (public); AWS Transit Gateway to AWS Site-to-Site VPN (VPN attachment); AWS Site-to-Site VPN to Customer gateway (IPsec); Customer gateway to Corporate servers (LAN).

text.tspan: HUB-AND-SPOKE NETWORK WITH CENTRAL INSPECTION ON AWS
Workload VPCs attach to a Transit Gateway that sends their internet traffic through Network Firewall in an inspection VPC; the data center joins the same hub over VPN
